title: 8 Hour Arousal (ORIGINAL)
description: I've been working on quite a few fun things for you loves... Using my voice, and HypnoticSwitch's Virtual Reality know how, we have created what is sure to be a fun new experience within your journey into hypnosis: Experience being programmed, in a virtual environment. Arousal. It's such a simple thing, such an ancient and primal feeling that builds up within us, often without control or the ability to consciously pull back. And here in this file... There will be no pulling back. Sink into the spirals as your arousal builds and builds and you sink deeper into mindless trance.
author: Mistress Shibby
